title: Police identify second suspect in condo double homicide
subtitle: Kwasi Skene-Peters, 21, of Toronto is wanted for two counts of first-degree murder.
article: Toronto police have issued an arrest warrant for a second suspect in the shooting death of two men last month.

Kwasi Skene-Peters, 21, of Toronto is wanted for two counts of first-degree murder in the deaths of Abdiwel Abdullahi, 26, and Mohamed Abdiwal Dirie, 26, who were pronounced dead on the scene after police were called to a condo in the Lisgar St. and Sudbury St. area around 7 a.m. on June 28 regarding a shooting.
Police say Skene-Peters is considered armed and dangerous and should not be approached.

Ellie Bergeron, a resident of the building, said she had heard loud music coming from the neighbouring unit for three days and was jolted awake early in the morning by gunfire . A young woman climbed from the unit where the shooting occurred onto Bergeron's balcony, "screaming bloody murder."
Last week, police charged Kamal Hassan, 23, of Toronto with two counts of first-degree murder after he turned himself in.
Anyone with information is asked to contact police at 416-808-7400 or Crime Stoppers anonymously at 416-222-8477.
